title: Why Negative 8 Is Colder Than Negative 3
description: Using the number line to compare two negative numbers without second-guessing.
narration_lines: Which is colder, negative eight degrees or negative three degrees?
On the number line, further left always means smaller.
Negative eight sits further to the left than negative three.
So negative eight degrees is the colder temperature.
